title: MetaWorks 2.0
description: MetaWorks 2.0 is a modular, API-backed, web-operable metabarcoding platform for ESV and OTU workflows. This release migrates the v1 Snakemake pipeline to a rule-module architecture, adds validated configuration management, replaces Perl helper scripts with Python, introduces FastAPI and Vue interfaces, and adds Docker Compose deployment.
